verdict.rationale: Supabase documents Database Webhooks that send real-time data to any external HTTP endpoint, including Edge Functions, on INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE table events. They are built as triggers over pg_net, so a user can subscribe an external system to database events. Missing for 10: documented webhook events beyond table changes (auth, storage or platform/account events), delivery details such as retries, signing and guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
